               Assignment 3: Q-Learning and Actor-Critic Algorithms

1     Introduction
The goal of this assignment is to experiment with value-based deep reinforcement learning algorithms. You
will implement Deep Q-Networks (DQN) for discrete action spaces and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) for continuous
action spaces.
The starter code for this assignment can be found at
           https://github.com/berkeleydeeprlcourse/homework_spring2026/tree/main/hw3
